checks.ref:
command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-code.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-code stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: R2 (packages/client/src/views/grid/MeetingHandle.tsx:53-89) is rated WARNING, but it describes an unmet requirement. Proposal NFR-P1 says re-placing the handles 're-renders a handle only when its row changes', and the grid-view delta spec (specs/grid-view/spec.md:22) says it 'MUST re-render a handle only when its row changes'. The code re-renders both MeetingHandleSliders, and re-runs their layout effect, on every change of the candidate run, even when getMeetingHandleRow gives the same row (e.g. run {1,5} to {1,6}). The review itself marks NFR-P1 ⚠️ and writes 'NFR-P1's scroll-time bound holds only partly'. The criteria list 'an unmet requirement' as CRITICAL, so R2 should be CRITICAL and NFR-P1 should not count as met.

The Verdict is not consistent with the findings. It says 'Ready — there is no CRITICAL finding, so nothing blocks the merge', then says R1 and R2 'should be fixed before merging' because NFR-P1 holds only partly. With NFR-P1 unmet (R2), the verdict must be not ready / blocking until R2 is fixed.
